{{Quote|There will be more innocent blood on your hands, Kenobi! Unless you come. Face me. Come alone. If you do not, this world will burn!|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in a hologram|<ref name="Revenge" />}}
'''Raydonia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists who lived there were known as Raydonians.

==Description==
[[File:Raydonia_Slaughter_Maul.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Maul after setting fire to the village.]]
Raydonia was similar to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in size, color (blue-green), and being completely covered with flora and fauna and overgrown with life. Its sky was filled with crimson clouds, similar to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir's]] sky.

==History==
Some time around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], there was a [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|skirmish]] above the planet. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] fought against [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], aboard a [[Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]].
